# Team {.unnumbered}

## Lecturers

:::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
::: {style="text-align: center;"}
![](images/team/alam.png){.img-circle style="float:right;" fig-alt="Headshot of Sahirul Alam" width="100"}
:::
::::

[**Dr. Ir. Sahirul Alam, S.T., M.Eng.**](https://acadstaff.ugm.ac.id/sahirulalam) (he/his) is an Indonesian academic, researcher, and lecturer at Universitas Gadjah Mada (UGM) in Yogyakarta, Indonesia. He currently serves as a faculty member in the Department of Electrical Engineering and Informatics (Departemen Teknik Elektro dan Informatika - DTEDI) within the Vocational College (Sekolah Vokasi) at UGM. In addition to his teaching duties, he holds the management position of Secretary for the Applied Bachelor (Sarjana Terapan) in Internet Engineering Technology (Teknologi Rekayasa Internet) study program.

Dr. Alam's research interests lie at the intersection of advanced telecommunications, network optimization, and computational engineering. His academic work primarily focuses on wireless communication systems (including Femtocell networks), RADAR signal processing, optimization methodologies, and the Internet of Things (IoT)..

[**Achmad Solaeman, S.Tr.T., M.Eng.**](https://acadstaff.ugm.ac.id/achmadsolaeman) (he/his) is an academic and lecturer in the Internet Engineering Technology program at the Vocational College, UGM. His expertise lies in Distributed Artificial Intelligence and Network Security, with active research in deep learning applications. He is dedicated to driving technological innovation and shaping future professionals in the networking and AI domains.

## Lab assistants

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
 
library(readr)
library(htmltools)
 
# Read team data
team <- read_csv(
  "data/team.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
 
# Image directory — path relative to rendered HTML output
# course/team.html → ../images/team/ resolves to images/team/ at site root
image_path <- "images/team/"
 
# Define class order
class_order <- c("RI5B1", "RI5B2", "RI5A1", "RI5A2")
 
# Inline styles for circle photo
# min-width/min-height prevent squishing to oval on narrow mobile screens
img_style <- paste0(
  "width:72px;height:72px;",
  "min-width:72px;min-height:72px;",
  "border-radius:50%;",
  "object-fit:cover;",
  "object-position:center top;",
  "display:block;margin:auto;"
)
 
td_photo_style  <- "text-align:center;padding:6px 10px;vertical-align:middle;min-width:84px;"
td_class_style  <- "text-align:center;font-weight:600;vertical-align:middle;padding:6px 12px;"
td_niu_style    <- "text-align:center;vertical-align:middle;padding:6px 12px;font-family:monospace;font-size:0.88em;"
td_name_style   <- "vertical-align:middle;padding:6px 12px;"
td_email_style  <- "vertical-align:middle;padding:6px 12px;font-size:0.85em;font-family:monospace;word-break:break-all;"
 
# Start table
html <- '
<table class="tabel-team" style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;">
  <colgroup>
    <col style="width:7%;">
    <col style="width:10%;">
    <col style="width:14%;">
    <col style="width:22%;">
    <col>
  </colgroup>
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th style="text-align:center;padding:6px 12px;">Class</th>
      <th style="text-align:center;padding:6px 12px;"></th>
      <th style="text-align:center;padding:6px 12px;">NIU</th>
      <th style="padding:6px 12px;">Name</th>
      <th style="padding:6px 12px;">Email</th>
    </tr>
  </thead>
  <tbody>
'
 
for (class_name in class_order) {
 
  members <- team[team$class == class_name, ]
  if (nrow(members) == 0) next
 
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(members))) {
 
    html <- paste0(html, "<tr>")
 
    # Class cell: rowspan for all members in this class
    if (i == 1) {
      html <- paste0(
        html,
        '<td rowspan="', nrow(members), '" style="', td_class_style, '">',
        class_name,
        '</td>'
      )
    }
 
    # Photo cell
    html <- paste0(
      html,
      '<td style="', td_photo_style, '">',
      '<img src="', image_path, members$photo[i], '"',
      ' alt="', members$name[i], '"',
      ' style="', img_style, '"',
      ' onerror="this.style.display=\'none\'">',
      '</td>'
    )
 
    # NIU cell
    html <- paste0(
      html,
      '<td style="', td_niu_style, '">',
      members$id[i],
      '</td>'
    )
 
    # Name cell
    html <- paste0(
      html,
      '<td style="', td_name_style, '">',
      members$name[i],
      '</td>'
    )
 
    # Email cell
    email_val <- if (!is.null(members$email) && !is.na(members$email[i])) members$email[i] else ""
    html <- paste0(
      html,
      '<td style="', td_email_style, '">',
      '<a href="mailto:', email_val, '">', email_val, '</a>',
      '</td>'
    )
 
    html <- paste0(html, "</tr>")
  }
}
 
html <- paste0(html, '\n  </tbody>\n</table>\n')
 
HTML(html)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_latex_output()
 
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
 
team <- read_csv("data/team.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
 
class_order <- c("RI5B1", "RI5B2", "RI5A1", "RI5A2")
team$class  <- factor(team$class, levels = class_order)
team        <- team[order(team$class), ]
 
team_pdf <- data.frame(
  Class = as.character(team$class),
  NIU   = team$id,
  Name  = team$name,
  Email = team$email
)
 
kable(team_pdf,
      format     = "latex",
      col.names  = c("Class", "NIU", "Name", "Email"),
      align      = c("c", "c", "l", "l"),
      escape     = TRUE,
      booktabs   = TRUE) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
                font_size = 9) |>
  column_spec(4, width = "5.5cm")
```
